policies.statement: Preserve the raw user request and label every derived context field as explicit, inferred, unknown, or absent.
policies.failure_behavior: block when inference can change scope, target, authority, or effect classification

policies.statement: Select the nearest uniquely supported declared CyberAlchemy-v2 route; Goal participates only on goal-specific evidence and is never a fallback.
policies.failure_behavior: gate on ambiguity and block on invalid or absent declared routes

policies.statement: After completion, reconcile plan-bound and interaction-bound proposals; continue directly only through one explicitly reversible, non-consequential, non-protected, non-owner-gated plan-bound option when no interaction-bound proposal survives.
policies.failure_behavior: gate interaction-bound, multiple, consequential, protected, irreversible, unknown, or owner-gated options; block zero admissible options

policies.statement: Agent, chat, or human interaction may formulate attributed continuation proposals, but proposal prose is candidate meaning and cannot qualify as direct until an attributable human decision binds its exact digest.
policies.failure_behavior: gate every unbound interaction proposal and block missing proposal identity, evidence, or selected dependencies

policies.statement: Bind every directive to the request or completion digest, verified decision-profile digest, selected source identities, and deterministic decision digest.
policies.failure_behavior: block on changed, missing, or ambiguous selected dependencies

policies.statement: Routing, gating, validation, model preference, and receipts remain non-authorizing; exact owners retain adoption and effect decisions.
policies.failure_behavior: block any attempted collapse from evidence into authority
